Files made by other tools, read by tests/unit/test_real_files.py (c2-972).

  Source: https://github.com/phuse-org/phuse-scripts, data/sdtm/cdiscpilot01/
  Licence: MIT (phuse-org/phuse-scripts). ts.xpt is Windows-1252 text.

adsl.json
  CDISC ADaM MSG ADSL as Dataset-JSON 1.1, written by the CDISC Dataset-JSON team.
  Source: https://github.com/cdisc-org/DataExchange-DatasetJson, examples/adam/adsl.json
